sn8.8:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhaterasehi bhikkhusatehi.
sn8.8:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā bhikkhū nibbānapaṭisaṃyuttāya dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti.
sn8.8:1.3: te ca bhikkhū aṭṭhikatvā manasikatvā sabbacetaso samannāharitvā ohitasotā dhammaṃ suṇanti.
sn8.8:1.5: ayaṃ kho bhagavā bhikkhū nibbānapaṭisaṃyuttāya dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti
sn8.8:1.6: te ca bhikkhū aṭṭhikatvā manasikatvā sabbacetaso samannāharitvā ohitasotā dhammaṃ suṇanti
sn8.8:1.7: yannūnāhaṃ bhagavantaṃ sammukhā sarūpāhi gāthāhi abhitthaveyyanti.
sn8.8:2.1: atha kho āyasmā vaṅgīso uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā tenañjalimpaṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn8.8:2.2: paṭibhāti maṃ bhagavā paṭibhāti maṃ sugatāti.
sn8.8:2.4: atha kho āyasmā vaṅgīso bhagavantaṃ sammukhā sarūpāhi gāthāhi abhitthavi
sn8.8:7.1: kiṃ nu te vaṅgīsa imā gāthāyo pubbe parivitakkitā udāhu ṭhānasova taṃ paṭibhantīti.
sn8.8:7.2: na kho me bhante imā gāthāyo pubbe parivitakkitā atha kho ṭhānasova maṃ paṭibhantīti.
sn8.8:7.3: tenahi taṃ vaṅgīsa bhiyyoso mattāya pubbe aparivitakkitā gāthāyo paṭibhantūti.
sn8.8:7.4: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā vaṅgīso bhagavato paṭissutvā bhiyyoso mattāya bhagavantaṃ pubbe aparivitakkitāhi gāthāhi abhitthavi
